title: Pure Dragunity
summary: The page's Glorious Gallery Dragunity build without its outside pieces: Mist Valley Baby Roc, Blackwing - Zephyros, Tempest, Crystal Wing and Bystial Dis Pater are left out, so the list is Dragunity cards and generic staples. Remus is the one-card starter: it fetches Dragon Ravine, which equips or mills Dragunities to set up the Synchro climb. The Glorious Gallery cards lead: Quirinus searches the Spells/Traps, Falchion equips Dragunity Dragons from the Deck, Divine Wind skips the Normal Summon, and Lord - Georgius locks the GY and negates Spells/Traps on the opponent's turn.
main: Dragunity Remus
The one-card starter: fetches Dragon Ravine and revives itself.
Dragunity Quirinus
Newest support. Summoned: searches a Dragunity Spell/Trap; swaps a Dragunity on the field for one from the hand.
Dragunity Falchion
Newest support. Banishes itself to equip a Dragunity Dragon from the Deck; sent from equip, banishes a card.
Dragunity Legatus
Summons itself next to Dragon Ravine or a Dragunity; destroys a Spell/Trap while a Dragunity is equipped.
Dragunity Phalanx
Level 2 Tuner that summons itself from the Spell & Trap Zone.
Dragunity Couse
Level 2 Tuner that changes Levels for the climb.
Dragunity Arma Mystletainn
Summons itself by sending an equip; bridges back into the Synchros.
Dragunity Dux
Normal Summoned: equips a Dragunity Dragon from the GY.
Dragon Ravine
Field Spell: discards to search a Level 4 or lower Dragunity or mill a Dragon.
Dragunity Divine Wind
Newest support. Returns a Dragon or Winged Beast and summons a Dragunity with an equip from the Deck.
Dragunity Divine Lance
Equip that equips a Dragunity Tuner from the Deck as well.
Dragunity Glow
Searches a Level 5+ Dragunity; from the GY, summons an equipped Monster Card.
Dragunity Oubliette
Counter Trap: negates a Spell/Trap while you control a Dragunity Synchro.
